description: The bar chart illustrates the ratio percentages of three language models—Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT—across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis displays the categories in order, while the vertical axis represents the ratio in percentage, ranging from 50% to 90% with 10% intervals. In the Movies category, Llama3 (blue) and Qwen2 (red) both exceed ChatGPT (yellow), with Llama3 reaching approximately 90% and Qwen2 slightly lower at around 91%. In the Songs category, Llama3 maintains a high ratio at about 84%, while Qwen2 drops significantly to approximately 90%, and ChatGPT is at around 62%. In the Basketball category, ChatGPT shows the highest ratio at approximately 61%, followed by Llama3 at 66% and Qwen2 at 58%. The legend at the top center identifies the models by color: blue for Llama3, red for Qwen2, and yellow for ChatGPT.
